title: Answer: by proof and by exact, vertex-by-vertex correspondence

statements.text: The claims are checked as mathematics: completeness proofs for the BF calculus, an isomorphism proof for the Q-Calculus, exact solutions with continuum limits for the discrete Dirac equation, and correspondences verified vertex by vertex for the Mereon geometry.

sources.quote: all 62 vertex directions are matched exactly, verified vertex by vertex
